phrases.ex: I don't want to cook. Let's eat out tonight.

phrases.en: I fell over on the ice.
phrases.ru: Я упал на льду. (fall over — упасть)
phrases.ex: What happened to your arm? / I fell over on the ice.
You need new shoes. / I know, my shoes are falling apart.

phrases.en: He fell for her straight away.
phrases.ru: Он сразу в неё влюбился. (fall for — влюбиться)
phrases.ex: How did they meet? / At work. He fell for her straight away.

phrases.en: Let's tidy up before they arrive.
phrases.ru: Давай приберёмся до их прихода. (tidy up — прибраться)
phrases.ex: The guests are coming at six. Let's tidy up before they arrive.

phrases.en: Who's going to clean up this mess?
phrases.ru: Кто будет убирать этот бардак? (clean up — убрать)
phrases.ex: Great party! But who's going to clean up this mess?
This old box is useless. / Don't throw it away! I need it.

phrases.en: I think I'm going to throw up.
phrases.ru: Кажется, меня сейчас стошнит. (throw up — тошнить)
phrases.ex: Stop the car! I think I'm going to throw up.

phrases.en: He passed out from the heat.
phrases.ru: Он потерял сознание от жары. (pass out — отключиться)
phrases.ex: Is he OK? / He passed out from the heat.
Is the room ready for the party? / Yes, they blew up the balloons.

phrases.en: Let's all chip in for a present.
phrases.ru: Давайте скинемся на подарок. (chip in — скинуться)
phrases.ex: It's Anna's birthday. Let's all chip in for a present.

phrases.en: The meeting dragged on for hours.
phrases.ru: Встреча затянулась на несколько часов. (drag on — затягиваться)
phrases.ex: Why are you so late? / The meeting dragged on for hours.

phrases.en: I didn't fit in at school.
phrases.ru: Я не вписывался в школьный коллектив. (fit in — вписаться)
phrases.ex: Did you like school? / Not really. I didn't fit in.
There's a spider! / Don't freak out! It's tiny.
Who broke the window? Nobody owned up.

phrases.ru: Перестань цепляться к брату! (pick on — придираться)
phrases.ex: He took my toy! / Stop picking on your brother!

phrases.en: We saw her off at the airport.
phrases.ru: Мы проводили её в аэропорту. (see off — проводить)
phrases.ex: Did Mum leave today? / Yes, we saw her off at the airport.

phrases.en: Your CV needs to stand out.
phrases.ru: Твоё резюме должно выделяться. (stand out — выделяться)
phrases.ex: Hundreds of people apply. Your CV needs to stand out.
What does BBC stand for? / British Broadcasting Corporation.
Why did you buy a dog? / My wife talked me into it.

phrases.ru: Учитель нас отругал. (tell off — отчитать, брит.)
phrases.ex: Why are you sad? / The teacher told us off for talking.

phrases.en: Think it over and let me know.
phrases.ru: Обдумай и дай мне знать. (think over — обдумать)
phrases.ex: I'm not sure about the job. / Think it over and let me know.
Want to go for a walk? / No, I'm worn out after work.
Tell them it's true. Back me up here!
Tell me everything that happened. Don't leave anything out.

phrases.en: He backed out at the last minute.
phrases.ru: Он отказался в последний момент. (back out — пойти на попятную)
phrases.ex: Is Tom coming on the trip? / No, he backed out at the last minute.

phrases.en: I need to brush up on my English.
phrases.ru: Мне нужно подтянуть английский. (brush up on — освежить знания)
phrases.ex: I've got an interview in London. I need to brush up on my English.

phrases.ru: Ну, я не уверен. (well — «ну», пауза перед ответом)
phrases.ex: Is the restaurant good? / Well, I'm not sure.

phrases.ru: Итак, какой план? (so — начать разговор, сменить тему)
phrases.ex: So, what's the plan for tonight?

phrases.ru: Так, давайте начнём. (right — брит., переход к делу)
phrases.ex: Right, let's start. Everyone's here.

phrases.ru: Так, в общем, дело вот в чём.
phrases.ex: OK, so here's the thing. I can't come to the wedding.

phrases.en: Actually, I'm from Kazan, not Moscow.
phrases.ru: Вообще-то я из Казани, а не из Москвы. (actually — на самом деле; не «актуально»!)
phrases.ex: So you're from Moscow? / Actually, I'm from Kazan, not Moscow.

phrases.ru: А ведь это хорошая идея. (actually — удивление)
phrases.ex: We could go by bike. / Actually, that's a good idea.

phrases.en: You know, I've never been to London.
phrases.ru: Знаешь, я никогда не был в Лондоне. (you know — «знаешь»)
phrases.ex: You know, I've never been to London.

phrases.en: I mean, it's not bad, but it's not great.
phrases.ru: В смысле, неплохо, но и не супер. (I mean — уточнение)
phrases.ex: Did you like the film? / I mean, it's not bad, but it's not great.

phrases.ru: В общем-то, нам нужно больше времени. (basically — по сути)
phrases.ex: What's the problem? / Basically, we need more time.

phrases.ru: Ну, типа, это было очень странно. (like — разговорное «типа», не злоупотребляйте)
phrases.ex: How was the party? / Like, it was really weird.

phrases.en: Listen, I need to tell you something.
phrases.ru: Слушай, мне нужно тебе кое-что сказать. (listen — привлечь внимание)
phrases.ex: Listen, I need to tell you something important.

phrases.ru: Слушай, это не моя вина. (look — с раздражением)
phrases.ex: You broke it! / Look, it's not my fault.

phrases.en: Know what? I'll come with you.
phrases.ru: Знаешь что? Я пойду с тобой.
phrases.ex: I'm going to the shops. / Know what? I'll come with you.

phrases.ru: Хм, сейчас посмотрим... (let me see — пауза, чтобы подумать)
phrases.ex: What time is the train? / Hmm, let me see... 4:15.
Do you like him? / How can I put it? He's... interesting.
It's a... what's the word? A corkscrew!
He's nice, but a bit strange. You know what I mean?
So we meet at ten, then drive together. Does that make sense?
Can you help me? / Just a second.

phrases.en: Wait a minute, that's not right.
phrases.ex: It's thirty pounds. / Wait a minute, that's not right.

phrases.ru: Так, на чём я остановился? (anyway — возврат к теме)
phrases.ex: Sorry, my phone rang. Anyway, where was I?

phrases.ru: Как бы то ни было, это не важно. (anyway — закрыть тему)
phrases.ex: Who said it first? Anyway, it doesn't matter.

phrases.en: Speaking of Tom, have you seen him?
phrases.ru: Кстати о Томе, ты его видел? (speaking of — раз уж речь зашла)
phrases.ex: Tom loves this café. Speaking of Tom, have you seen him?

phrases.en: Talking of holidays, where are you going this year?
phrases.ru: Кстати об отпуске, куда ты едешь в этом году? (talking of — брит.)
phrases.ex: I need a holiday. / Talking of holidays, where are you going this year?
Oh, and another thing... don't forget your passport.
Where shall we eat? / Honestly, I don't mind.

phrases.en: If I'm honest, I'm a bit scared.
phrases.ex: Are you excited about the trip? / If I'm honest, I'm a bit scared.

phrases.en: To tell you the truth, I forgot.
phrases.ex: Did you call your mum? / To tell you the truth, I forgot.

phrases.ru: Откровенно говоря, это была катастрофа. (frankly — откровенно)
phrases.ex: How was the presentation? / Frankly, it was a disaster.

phrases.en: To be fair, he did try.
phrases.ru: Справедливости ради, он старался. (to be fair — брит.)
phrases.ex: He failed the test. / To be fair, he did try.

phrases.en: Seriously, you have to try this.
phrases.ex: Seriously, you have to try this cake. It's amazing.

phrases.ru: К счастью, никто не пострадал. (luckily — к счастью)
phrases.ex: There was a fire. Luckily, nobody was hurt.

phrases.ru: К сожалению, магазин был закрыт. (unfortunately — к сожалению)
phrases.ex: Did you buy the milk? / Unfortunately, the shop was closed.
We're going to the beach tomorrow. Hopefully, it'll be sunny.

phrases.ru: Говорят, он переезжает в Испанию. (apparently — судя по всему, по слухам)
phrases.ex: Have you heard about Mark? Apparently, he's moving to Spain.

phrases.ru: Разумеется, я помогу тебе с переездом. (obviously — очевидно, разумеется)
phrases.ex: Are you free on Saturday? / Obviously, I'll help you move.

phrases.en: Of course, you're welcome to stay.
phrases.ex: Can I sleep on your sofa? / Of course, you're welcome to stay.

phrases.ru: Ты же не всерьёз? (surely — выражает удивление)
phrases.ex: I'm going to quit my job tomorrow. / Surely you're not serious?

phrases.en: In fact, it was the opposite.
phrases.ru: На самом деле всё было наоборот. (in fact — на самом деле)
phrases.ex: Was he angry? / No. In fact, it was the opposite. He was happy.

phrases.en: As a matter of fact, I do.
phrases.ru: Вообще-то да. (as a matter of fact — на самом деле)
phrases.ex: You don't know anyone here, do you? / As a matter of fact, I do.

phrases.en: Believe it or not, he passed.
phrases.ru: Хочешь верь, хочешь нет, но он сдал.
phrases.ex: Did Sam pass his driving test? / Believe it or not, he passed!

phrases.en: Funnily enough, I was just thinking about you.
phrases.ru: Как ни странно, я как раз о тебе думал. (брит.)
phrases.ex: Hi, it's Anna! / Funnily enough, I was just thinking about you.

phrases.ru: И ещё, не забудь паспорт. (also — также)
phrases.ex: Bring warm clothes. Also, don't forget your passport.

phrases.ru: К тому же это дешевле. (plus — к тому же, разг.)
phrases.ex: Let's take the train. It's faster. Plus, it's cheaper.

phrases.ru: Кроме того, уже слишком поздно. (besides — кроме того)
phrases.ex: I don't want to go out. Besides, it's too late now.

phrases.en: What's more, the food was cold.
phrases.ru: Более того, еда была холодной. (what's more — более того)
phrases.ex: The service was slow. What's more, the food was cold.

phrases.en: On top of that, it started raining.
phrases.ru: Вдобавок ко всему пошёл дождь. (on top of that — вдобавок)
phrases.ex: We missed the bus. On top of that, it started raining.

phrases.ru: Не говоря уже о цене. (not to mention — не говоря уже о)
phrases.ex: The hotel was dirty and noisy. Not to mention the price!

phrases.en: I can't boil an egg, let alone cook dinner.
phrases.ru: Я и яйцо сварить не могу, не то что ужин приготовить. (let alone — не говоря уже о)
phrases.ex: Can you cook for the party? / I can't boil an egg, let alone cook dinner.
The flat is perfect. However, there's one problem. It's very expensive.

phrases.en: Mind you, it was very cheap.
phrases.ru: Правда, это было очень дёшево. (mind you — оговорка, брит.)
phrases.ex: The hotel wasn't great. Mind you, it was very cheap.

phrases.en: Having said that, I'd go again.
phrases.ru: Но при этом я бы поехал ещё раз. (having said that — тем не менее)
phrases.ex: It rained every day. Having said that, I'd go again.

phrases.ru: И всё же оно того стоило. (still — тем не менее)
phrases.ex: The tickets were expensive. Still, it was worth it.

phrases.en: Even so, I'm glad I went.
phrases.ru: И всё-таки я рад, что сходил. (even so — и всё же)
phrases.ex: The film was too long. Even so, I'm glad I went.

phrases.ru: Хотя было приятно. (though в конце фразы — «хотя», разг.)
phrases.ex: The weekend was too short. It was nice, though.

phrases.en: Though I must admit, it was fun.
phrases.ru: Хотя должен признать, было весело. (though — хотя)
phrases.ex: I didn't want to go dancing. Though I must admit, it was fun.

phrases.en: I love tea, whereas my wife prefers coffee.
phrases.ru: Я люблю чай, а моя жена предпочитает кофе. (whereas — тогда как)
phrases.ex: Do you both drink tea? / No. I love tea, whereas my wife prefers coffee.

phrases.ru: Вместо этого мы остались дома. (instead — вместо этого)
phrases.ex: Did you go to the cinema? / No. Instead, we stayed at home.
Leave now. Otherwise, we'll be late.

phrases.en: In that case, let's take a taxi.
phrases.ru: В таком случае давай возьмём такси. (in that case — в таком случае)
phrases.ex: The buses aren't running. / In that case, let's take a taxi.

phrases.ru: В любом случае я тебе позвоню. (either way — в любом случае)
phrases.ex: I might be late, or I might not come. Either way, I'll call you.

phrases.en: In any case, it's too late.
phrases.ru: Как бы там ни было, уже поздно. (in any case — в любом случае)
phrases.ex: Should we call them? / In any case, it's too late now.

phrases.ru: По крайней мере, мы попытались. (at least — по крайней мере)
phrases.ex: We didn't win. / At least we tried.

phrases.ru: В конце концов, ему всего пять. (after all — ведь, всё-таки)
phrases.ex: Don't be angry with him. After all, he's only five.

phrases.en: At the end of the day, it's your choice.
phrases.ru: В конечном счёте это твой выбор. (at the end of the day — разг.)
phrases.ex: Should I study medicine? / At the end of the day, it's your choice.
The bus broke down. That's why I'm late.
He's got a new girlfriend. / So that's why he's so happy!
Why weren't you at work? / That's because I was ill.

phrases.en: Because of the snow, the school closed.
phrases.ru: Из-за снега школу закрыли. (because of — из-за)
phrases.ex: Why are the kids at home? / Because of the snow, the school closed.

phrases.ru: Благодаря тебе я сдал. (thanks to — благодаря)
phrases.ex: Thanks to you, I passed the exam! / Well done!

phrases.en: As a result, the flight was cancelled.
phrases.ru: В результате рейс отменили. (as a result — в результате)
phrases.ex: There was a storm. As a result, the flight was cancelled.

phrases.en: Let's leave now so that we don't miss the train.
phrases.ru: Давай выйдем сейчас, чтобы не опоздать на поезд. (so that — чтобы)
phrases.ex: It's only eight. / Let's leave now so that we don't miss the train.

phrases.en: I'm saving in order to buy a car.
phrases.ru: Я коплю, чтобы купить машину. (in order to — для того чтобы)
phrases.ex: Why do you work weekends? / I'm saving in order to buy a car.

phrases.ru: Мы пойдём, если не будет дождя. (unless — если не)
phrases.ex: Are we having the picnic? / Yes, we'll go unless it rains.

phrases.en: As long as you're back by ten.
phrases.ru: Если только ты вернёшься к десяти. (as long as — при условии что)
phrases.ex: Can I go to the party? / As long as you're back by ten.
Why are you taking a coat? It's sunny. / Just in case.

phrases.en: Even though it was raining, we went out.
phrases.ru: Хотя шёл дождь, мы пошли гулять. (even though — хотя)
phrases.ex: Did you stay in? / No. Even though it was raining, we went out.

phrases.en: Although he's rich, he's not happy.
phrases.ru: Хотя он богат, он несчастлив. (although — хотя)
phrases.ex: Although he's rich, he's not happy. Money isn't everything.

phrases.en: Despite the rain, we had fun.
phrases.ru: Несмотря на дождь, мы повеселились. (despite — несмотря на)
phrases.ex: How was the festival? / Despite the rain, we had fun.

phrases.en: In spite of everything, we're still friends.
phrases.ru: Несмотря ни на что, мы всё ещё друзья. (in spite of — несмотря на)
phrases.ex: You argued a lot. / Yes, but in spite of everything, we're still friends.

phrases.en: First of all, thank you for coming.
phrases.ru: Прежде всего, спасибо, что пришли. (first of all — прежде всего)
phrases.ex: First of all, thank you for coming. Let's begin.

phrases.en: To start with, it's too expensive.
phrases.ru: Начнём с того, что это слишком дорого. (to start with — для начала)
phrases.ex: Why don't you like the plan? / To start with, it's too expensive.

phrases.en: At first, I didn't like it.
phrases.ru: Сначала мне не понравилось. (at first — сначала)
phrases.ex: Do you like London? / At first, I didn't like it. Now I love it.
Mix the flour and sugar. Then, add the eggs.

phrases.en: After that, we went to the beach.
phrases.ru: После этого мы пошли на пляж. (after that — после этого)
phrases.ex: We had lunch in town. After that, we went to the beach.

phrases.ru: А тем временем я заварю чай. (meanwhile — тем временем)
phrases.ex: The cake needs twenty minutes. Meanwhile, I'll make some tea.

phrases.en: In the meantime, have a seat.
phrases.ru: Пока что присаживайтесь. (in the meantime — пока что)
phrases.ex: The doctor is busy. In the meantime, have a seat.

phrases.en: In the end, we took the train.
phrases.ru: В итоге мы поехали на поезде. (in the end — в итоге)
phrases.ex: Did you drive? / We wanted to, but in the end, we took the train.

phrases.ru: В конце концов он согласился. (eventually — в конце концов, а не «возможно»!)
phrases.ex: Did your dad let you go? / Eventually, he said yes.

phrases.en: Finally, I'd like to thank my family.
phrases.ru: И наконец, я хотел бы поблагодарить свою семью. (finally — наконец)
phrases.ex: Finally, I'd like to thank my family for their support.
How's the new job? / So far, so good.

phrases.en: For example, you could take the bus.
phrases.ru: Например, можно поехать на автобусе. (for example — например)
phrases.ex: How do I get there? / For example, you could take the bus.
There are lots of things to do here. / Such as?

phrases.ru: Другими словами, мы на мели. (in other words — другими словами)
phrases.ex: We've spent all our savings. In other words, we're broke.

phrases.en: Just to be clear, I'm not angry.
phrases.ru: Просто чтобы было понятно: я не злюсь.
phrases.ex: Just to be clear, I'm not angry. I'm just tired.

phrases.en: As I said, I can't come on Friday.
phrases.ru: Как я уже говорил, в пятницу я не смогу. (as I said — как я уже сказал)
phrases.ex: Are you coming on Friday? / As I said, I can't come on Friday.

phrases.en: As far as I know, the shop is open.
phrases.ru: Насколько я знаю, магазин открыт. (as far as I know — насколько я знаю)
phrases.ex: Is the shop open today? / As far as I know, it is.

phrases.en: If I remember rightly, it was in 2019.
phrases.ru: Если я правильно помню, это было в 2019-м. (брит.)
phrases.ex: When did you move? / If I remember rightly, it was in 2019.

phrases.ru: Вообще говоря, здесь безопасно. (generally speaking — в целом)
phrases.ex: Is this area safe? / Generally speaking, it's safe here.

phrases.ru: В целом я доволен. (overall — в целом)
phrases.ex: How was the course? / Some parts were hard, but overall, I'm happy.

phrases.en: On the whole, people were friendly.
phrases.ru: В общем и целом люди были дружелюбными. (on the whole — в целом)
phrases.ex: How did you find Scotland? / On the whole, people were friendly.

phrases.en: All in all, it was a great trip.
phrases.ru: В целом это была отличная поездка. (all in all — в общем)
phrases.ex: There were some problems, but all in all, it was a great trip.

phrases.en: I literally ran all the way.
phrases.ru: Я буквально всю дорогу бежал. (literally — разговорное усиление)
phrases.ex: How did you get here so fast? / I literally ran all the way.
Are you coming tonight? / Absolutely!
Wasn't that film amazing? / Totally!
Can you send me the photos? / Sure thing!
Turn left, then second right. / Right, got it.
Are you finished? / Pretty much.
Do you understand the rules? / More or less.
So he's a doctor? / Something like that. He works in a hospital.

phrases.en: We watched films and stuff like that.
phrases.ru: Мы смотрели фильмы и всё такое. (and stuff like that — и всё такое, разг.)
phrases.ex: What did you do at the weekend? / We watched films and stuff like that.

phrases.en: Let's get a pizza or something.
phrases.ru: Давай возьмём пиццу или что-нибудь такое. (or something — или что-то вроде)
phrases.ex: I'm hungry. / Let's get a pizza or something.

phrases.ru: Да как хочешь. / Мне всё равно. (часто звучит грубовато)
phrases.ex: Shall we go now or later? / Whatever.

phrases.ru: Ну что ж, ничего страшного. (oh well — смирение с ситуацией)
phrases.ex: Sorry, the shop has sold out. / Oh well, never mind.
I've got the tickets! / Brilliant!
Your coffee, madam. / Lovely, thank you!
Here's your pen. / Cheers, mate.
Here's your tea. / Ta!
I've booked the hotel. / Sorted!

phrases.ru: Классно, правда? (right? — в конце фразы, ожидая согласия)
phrases.ex: This view! It's amazing, right?
It's cold today, isn't it? / Freezing!

phrases.en: You went to Paris last year, didn't you?
phrases.ru: Ты же ездил в Париж в прошлом году? (разделительный вопрос)
phrases.ex: You went to Paris last year, didn't you? / Yes, in May.

phrases.en: That was a great film, wasn't it?
